open: Platform grouping: OSM tags platforms '2', 'La0203', '3', '4'; lifts reach '2'+'La0203' together and '3'+'4' together. Digitraffic gives tracks 1 and 4 at 451 m and 2 and 3 at 270 m, which suggests islands 1/2 and 3/4 (La0203 = track 1 face?), but no source states which tracks share a platform.
Which underpass is which (west tunnel renovated 2006 vs. the 2016 travel-centre tunnel) and their signposted names: not found.
Lift renovation (VR: 28 Sep–18 Oct 2026) — VR did not say which lift; presumably finished by 2026-10-30, not confirmed.
Station hall opening: VR 05:00, Visit Lahti 05:30 (both close 23:15). VR used.
Ravintola Asema and Cafe Express hours are OSM only; no own websites found.
Toilet fee amount not stated by VR or the area map; fee=yes is OSM only.
Visit Lahti mentions a station office Mo-Fr 06:30-18:00, but VR lists no VR service point: left out as probably stale.

answers.question: (no open-question list for Finland yet; brief priority 1: levels, which platforms have stairs/lifts, entrances, hours)
answers.answer: Platform tracks 1–4 (Digitraffic) on two platforms reached from underpasses along Vesijärvenkatu–Uudenmaankatu; levels linked by lifts or stairs (Visit Lahti). OSM has two lifts and several stairs to each platform. Station hall 05:00-23:15 (VR). In the building: R-kioski, Ravintola Asema, Cafe Express, toilets, Otto, KeyBoy lockers, car rental desks.
